body:
"dataman" wrote in message ...
>why can not find anyone talk about?

I'll talk about him.  I think that the Unabomber is cool.  The entire
thing is very entertaining to me - a deranged hermit living in a shack
without electricity or water sending mailbombs to people he doesn't
like in an attempt to destroy the technological-industrial system.
I've read the Manifesto numerous times and have memorized quite a few
paragraphs.  What's scary is that it's hard to argue with his ideas.

"In order to get our message before the public with some chance
of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto
